title: world_state
summary: Benilla defines SMSG_INIT_WORLD_STATES (u32 map, u32 zone, u16 count, count x raw (id,value) dword pairs incl. the (0,0) terminator) and SMSG_UPDATE_WORLD_STATE (one pair), feeding the NPC-text $<n>w/$<n>e macro expander. MSUI implements both in Program.Quest.cs (ApplyInitialWorldStates/ApplyWorldState with exact-length validation, raw dwords into _questWorldStates) with QuestTextMacroLaw as the same consumer.
